# READ-ONLY REFERENCE — Do Not Edit

This tree is an **older iOS Swift prototype**, kept for reference only. It is not the active app.

- **Do not edit** anything under this directory unless an objective explicitly targets `src/legacy-ios/` and has been approved by the Human Reviewer.
- The active Swift app is **[`src/native/Transcriber2/`](../native/Transcriber2/)**. If you intended to work on the Transcriber app, you are in the wrong directory.
- No Xcode project exists in this tree — it is source files only, organized by feature (Audio, Diarization, Models, Processing, Storage, Transcription, Views).
- Whether this tree has unique reference value (e.g. its custom diarization clustering or Whisper C bridge) not already superseded by the active app, and whether it should be archived, is an **open decision** — see [docs/planning/INVENTORY_REPORT.md](../../docs/planning/INVENTORY_REPORT.md) and [DECISIONS.md](../../DECISIONS.md) D-001 / D-017.

See [CLAUDE.md](../../CLAUDE.md) for the full multi-app registry and guardrails.
